title: prismreed pith (x6)

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: Brew the pith into a charged coating, then throw the bottle to electrify a target. Thin veins gleam through the pith. Split stems raise a faint crackle under the knife.

sections.heading: Use & mechanics
sections.text: Tactical use: Spend one pith to wick one temporary thin liquid coating from nearby ground, or up to 20 units of oil, pitch, honey or bog mire from yourself or a willing adjacent party companion. Body wicking leaves Wet, poison and burning unchanged. Pools, permanent sources and ice remain. Choose its inventory action while in reach; success costs one action.

sections.heading: Field uses
sections.text:
prismreed pith (x6)

Field cleanup
Spend one pith to wick up to 20 units of oil, pitch, honey or bog mire from yourself or an adjacent, visible, nonhostile party companion. The pith and absorbed liquid are discarded. Any remaining coating keeps its effects until it is gone; other conditions and prior injuries remain.

Ground cleanup
One pith can wick a temporary thin film from nearby ground. It cannot drain pools or permanent liquid sources; other ground hazards remain.

Brewing
Use the pith in brewing a charged coating, then throw the bottle to electrify a target.
